note: File-name patterns used by the file input adapter to recognise export sets and to estimate stem roles (docs/SPEC.md 6.1.1, 6.1.3; D-028..D-032, D-037). Detection is always an estimate from names and is recorded as such. Names are matched after Unicode NFC normalisation; 'stem_regex' / 'fullmix_regex' see the file name without extension as-is, 'role_map' keys and keyword rules see the normalised name (casefolded, runs of '_', '-', '.' and whitespace collapsed to one space). New services or DAWs are added by appending a pattern set; no code change is needed.

pattern_sets.label: Suno Studio multitrack export
pattern_sets.notes: Stem count varies per song (up to 12 observed); the count is never assumed. Roles come from the part name, never from the number. Number 0 carries the song title and is the bundled full mix.

derived_sum_patterns.note: Files that are sums of other stems (e.g. 'other' and 'no_vocals' found next to a conformed Suno set, D-037). Importing them would add the same sound twice, so they are skipped by default with a warning. 'other' is only treated as a sum when the folder also holds stems for several of the roles such a sum would contain; a lone 'other' stem from a 4-stem separator is a real stem.

generic_keyword_rules.note: Fallback for folders that match no pattern set. Ordered: the first matching rule wins, so specific words (bass drum, bassoon, backing vocals, full mix) come before generic ones (bass, vocal, mix). Regexes are case-insensitive and run on the normalised name.
